rationalization.consequence: The wet well overflows the bench
rationalization.required_action: Start a pump and investigate why the demand did not call one

rationalization.consequence: The wet well pumps dry and the running pumps cavitate
rationalization.required_action: Stop the running pumps and investigate the low level

rationalization.consequence: The backup level instrument carries the station unnoticed
rationalization.required_action: Check the primary level instrument

rationalization.consequence: The backup level instrument has failed while the primary still serves — failover redundancy is already lost
rationalization.required_action: Repair the backup level instrument before the primary fails

rationalization.consequence: No pump is available; the station cannot pump
rationalization.required_action: Restore a pump to service or clear its faults

rationalization.consequence: Every pump is faulted; the station cannot pump
rationalization.required_action: Dispatch maintenance to clear the pump faults

rationalization.consequence: Station power is lost; the pumps cannot run
rationalization.required_action: Switch to backup power and investigate the supply

rationalization.consequence: Command and running feedback disagree; operation is not confirmed
rationalization.required_action: Stop the request or take the pump out of service, then inspect the motor and feedback

rationalization.consequence: The motor overheats and the pump trips out
rationalization.required_action: Investigate the thermal overload and reset the contact

rationalization.consequence: Water ingress degrades the motor insulation
rationalization.required_action: Schedule a seal inspection for the pump
